data.one_liner: Instagram stories like UI with animations and customizability.
data.what_it_does: Provides a StoryPageView widget that mimics Instagram stories UI, complete with progress indicators, image loading coordination, custom story lengths per page, and animation controllers.
use_when: You need to implement Instagram-style stories in your app.
You want built-in indicators and gesture handling for timed story views.
avoid_when: You need complex video streaming or multi-platform native story wrappers.
You want generic carousel or slider components without story behavior.
strengths: Includes StoryImage widget that pauses indicators while images load.
Provides animation controllers to pause and resume indicators.
Supports gesture item builders for overlays like close buttons.
weaknesses: Gesture widgets cannot be directly placed inside itemBuilder due to underlying default gestures.
Limited to custom story implementations via StoryPageView.
